packs.name: anomaly-detection
packs.summary: Find unusual rows (fraud, faults, outliers) in tabular data without labels, with Isolation Forest.

recipes.good_for: Unlabelled tabular data where anomalies are rare (< 5%) and look different from normal rows; fast on millions of rows.

packs.name: diffusion-lora
packs.summary: Teach Stable Diffusion 1.x/2.x a subject or style from a folder of captioned images with a small UNet LoRA.

recipes.good_for: A person, pet, product, character or art style from 5–50 images (instance_prompt with a rare token like "sks"), or a domain look from hundreds of captioned images; fits SD 1.5 at 512 px in 8 GB.

packs.name: embedding-finetune
packs.summary: Fine-tune a sentence-embedding model on your own (query, relevant passage) pairs for better search, retrieval and RAG.

recipes.good_for: Domain search / RAG retrieval / FAQ matching from 500+ (query, relevant passage) pairs; MiniLM trains on CPU in minutes, larger encoders want a GPU.

packs.name: image-classification
packs.summary: Classify images into categories by fine-tuning a pretrained timm CNN/ViT (folder-per-class data).

recipes.good_for: Product photos, defects, documents, medical-style categories; 50+ images per class; GPU strongly recommended, small models run on CPU.

packs.name: image-segmentation
packs.summary: Label every pixel of an image (semantic segmentation) by fine-tuning a torchvision LR-ASPP / DeepLabV3 model.

recipes.good_for: Pixel masks of regions (defect areas, crop/weed, road/sky, tissue types, water/land); 50+ annotated images; lraspp_mobilenet_v3_large runs on CPU, DeepLabV3 wants a GPU.

packs.name: llm-finetune
packs.summary: Fine-tune an open LLM on your instructions/chats with LoRA or QLoRA (4-bit) on one NVIDIA GPU.

recipes.good_for: Teach a 0.5B–8B open model a style, format or domain from 200+ prompt/response pairs; QLoRA fits 7–8B in 8–12 GB VRAM.

packs.name: llm-preference
packs.summary: Align an open LLM with chosen/rejected answer pairs using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) on a LoRA/QLoRA adapter.

recipes.good_for: Make a 0.5B–8B instruct model prefer one kind of answer over another (tone, safety, conciseness, format) from 300+ prompt/chosen/rejected pairs; optionally on top of an llm-finetune (SFT) adapter.

packs.name: object-detection
packs.summary: Find and box objects in images by fine-tuning a torchvision Faster R-CNN (CSV or COCO annotations).

recipes.good_for: Locating and counting objects (products on shelves, defects, vehicles, animals) with boxes; 100+ labelled boxes per class; COCO-pretrained so small datasets work; GPU recommended, the mobilenet model runs on CPU.

packs.name: recommendation
packs.summary: Recommend items to users from an interaction log (purchases, clicks, ratings) with implicit ALS or item-kNN.

recipes.good_for: Purchase / click / play logs (implicit feedback) with repeat users; learns taste factors, so it finds non-obvious items and similar items; up to ~1M users x 100k items on CPU.
Fast, explainable "people who bought X also bought Y" baseline; strong on small or very sparse logs; no iterations to tune.

packs.name: reinforcement-learning
packs.summary: Train an agent to act in a Gymnasium environment or your own simulator with Stable-Baselines3 (PPO, A2C, DQN, SAC).

recipes.good_for: Control and decision problems with a simulator (Gymnasium env id or your own make_env() in a .py file); small MLP policies train faster on CPU than on GPU, use a GPU only for CnnPolicy on image observations.

packs.name: speech-recognition
packs.summary: Fine-tune OpenAI Whisper to transcribe your own recordings (accents, domain words, a language) from audio + transcript pairs.

recipes.good_for: Improve transcription of accented speech, jargon, product names or a lower-resource language from 1+ hour of clips (<= 30 s) with exact transcripts; GPU strongly recommended (whisper-small needs ~8 GB VRAM), CPU only for whisper-tiny/base.

packs.name: tabular-classic
packs.summary: Classic machine learning for tabular (CSV) data. CPU only, fast, explainable baselines.

recipes.good_for: First baseline for classification; small-to-medium data; needs explainable coefficients.
Strong default for tabular data; handles non-linearity and mixed feature types with little tuning.

packs.name: text-classification
packs.summary: Classify text (sentiment, intent, topic, spam...) from a CSV with a text column and a label column.

recipes.good_for: First baseline for any language; seconds to train on CPU; strong for topic, spam and keyword-driven labels.
Best accuracy when context matters; 1k+ labelled examples; any language with a multilingual model.

packs.name: timeseries-forecast
packs.summary: Forecast the next values of one or many numeric time series (sales, demand, load, traffic) with lag features + gradient boosting.

recipes.good_for: One regular series (daily/hourly/weekly) with 100+ points; captures trend-free seasonality and recent momentum.
Many related series in one CSV (sales per store/product, load per meter); short series borrow patterns from long ones.
